title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3031 Veterans Road West in Staten Island, New York, as the "Leonard Montalto Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3031 Veterans Road West in Staten Island, New York, as the "Leonard Montalto Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Staten Island, New York post office building after Leonard Montalto.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3031 Veterans Road West in Staten Island, New York, as the "Leonard Montalto Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
